content: Hello, I am Alder Credit's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Ellis Green?
Yes, this is Ellis Green speaking.
Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions. Could you please tell me your postcode?
And what is your year of birth?
Thank you. I am calling about overdue payments. Your credit card has 900.00 past due and is 4 days late. Can you pay the full past-due amount today?
I can't pay it today, but I can promise to pay the full 900 pounds on October fifteenth, which is tomorrow. Would that be a promise to pay later, or would you be taking money from my account now?
This would be a promise to pay later. To confirm: the credit card, 900.00 on Thursday 15 October 2026. Do you confirm this?
Yes, I confirm: a promise to pay 900 pounds on my credit card on Thursday, 15 October 2026.
Your promise is recorded: the credit card, 900.00 on Thursday 15 October 2026. A letter confirming the promise will be sent. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's everything, thank you. Goodbye.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
